summary: I fixed the bug in `solution/core.py`, the only file I changed, and the visible suite now passes (2 passed). The cause was in the code that handles escaped quotes inside a quoted field: when the parser found a `"`, it checked whether the next character was a single quote (`'`) instead of another double quote (`"`). In CSV, a doubled `""` inside a quoted field stands for one literal `"`. Because of the wrong check, the parser treated the first `"` of a doubled pair as the end of the field, then hit the second `"` and raised "character after closing quote". I changed that check to look for `"` at `line[i + 1]`, so a `""` pair now becomes a single `"` in the output and the parser keeps reading the field.
